scenes.title: Microsoft Plugin Architecture: reuse the core, govern each host
scenes.body: Bottom line: standardize skills and MCP, then govern compatibility and ownership for each host.
scenes.narration: Bottom line: standardize skills and MCP, then govern compatibility and ownership for each host.
claims: Three host routes use different delivery contracts: Cowork uses Microsoft 365 app packages; declarative agents use MCP or API actions; GitHub Copilot uses plugin packages.
Skills and MCP configuration can be reusable, while manifests, discovery, authentication and client-specific components remain host-specific.
Cowork packages skills and connectors in a standard Microsoft 365 app package.
Microsoft 365 declarative agents support MCP and REST API plugins as in-agent actions; REST API tools are defined in the plugin manifest.
GitHub Agent Plugins 1.0 ports skills and MCP configuration across compatible clients; client-specific components and legacy plugins remain supported.
claimSources: [ev-04] MCP and API plugins for declarative agents

scenes.title: 4. Govern a small portfolio
scenes.body: Assign one owner per capability and service. Publish a host compatibility matrix, version each package, and add routes only when demand justifies lifecycle cost.
